sources.title: Piracy monthly report May 2025
sources.text: Duty crew onboard a tanker underway noticed two unauthorised persons attempting to open the poop deck rope store hatch cover. Alarm raised, crew mustered and deck lights switched on. Seeing the crew alertness, the persons escaped without stealing anything. Incident reported to Singapore VTIS.
